input.question: What is the population of Furna according to the 2010 census?

documents.text: Furna (Brava) Furna is a seaside community in the northeastern part of the island of Brava, Cape Verde. It lies 2.5 km northeast of the island capital of Nova Sintra. At the 2010 census its population was 612. The settlement was mentioned as "Fuurno" in the 1747 map by Jacques-Nicolas Bellin. Furna became the most important harbour of Brava in 1843. In 1982, many boats and some houses of Furna were destroyed by waves reaching a height of up to 10 meters which were caused by the tropical storm "Beryl". The harbour was improved in 2000.
